item.description: In celebration of what makes the community of Cotgrave special, Allison Homes has revealed that its upcoming development will be named “Hayes View” in honour of local hero Ernest Hayes. item.description: A man has been charged following a fatal road collision on A610 Nuthall Road, Whitemoor. item.title: Former Highbury Vale Community Centre site declared surplus as council moves towards sale
item.description: Nottingham City Council will declare the former Highbury Vale Community Centre in Bestwood surplus to its operational requirements, paving the way for the site to be sold and potentially redeveloped after several years standing empty.
